scope: The printer is found on the LAN by its serial number. The optional address overrides discovery for video and files. The cloud account stays active.
invalid: Invalid configuration or save rejected. Use a private IPv4 without URL or port.
hybrid: Automatic camera over the local network · cloud account stays active.
camera-experimental-disabled: Hybrid camera has not been enabled by the server administrator.
camera-disabled: Camera disabled. Cloud monitoring remains available.
camera-cloud-unqualified: Remote Cloud video is not qualified. No remote transport is started.
camera-host-required: Printer not found on the local network. Check server connectivity or enter the address in settings.
